teaser: The new data lake: append-only lanes instead of one lake, a curator agent that builds a semantic graph, and a graph that draws its own infographics.
core_idea: The next data lake is many small append-only lanes of signed rows, a curator agent that turns them into a semantic graph whose every node points back at its rows, and a graph that draws its own pictures; insight is a claim with its evidence. PrompTugal.news and Storm Charles ran this way in November 2026.
